sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is the latest model in the MiniCPM-V series, available in a 35B-A3B variant, with 35B-A3B being the first MoE model in the MiniCPM-V series. It builds on the family's single-image, multi-image, and video understanding capabilities, combining stronger foundation capabilities with efficient visual encoding and on-device inference.

sources.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V is a series of efficient multimodal large language models developed by OpenBMB. Like MiniCPM-V 4.6, the MiniCPM-V 4.7 architecture pairs a SigLIP vision encoder that has a window-attention merger with a Qwen3.5 language model backbone, and supports both 4x and 16x visual downsampling modes.

sources.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B: Local Testing Results for OCR, SQL and Physics
sources.snippet: Hands-on local test of MiniCPM-V 4.7, an Apache 2.0 vision MoE model, covering OCR, SQL debugging, physics reasoning and multilingual translation.
